'''2001 I-10 Cup''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament weekend in Arizona held before 22 January 2001. Players posting on DeckTech also called it the "I-10 Championship".<ref name="dt-13100">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13100 Court for the AGES], DeckTech (Justin "Bubba Joe" Beal, 22 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13100/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13100/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018071423/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13100/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="dt-13121">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13121 Fortress], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 23 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13121/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13121/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018063923/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13121/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 20–21 January 2001<ref name="tr-d1666" />
* '''Site:''' Arizona; Kards 4 You, Tucson, Arizona (day 1, 20 January); Gamer's Edge, Chandler, Arizona (day 2, 21 January)<ref name="tr-d1658" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]<ref name="tr-d1658" />
* '''Players:''' 19 on day 1, 13 on day 2 (10 played both days)<ref name="tr-d1658" />

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Justin Beal I-10 Cup Tucson Phoenix 1-20-21-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Justin Beal]], 11th of 19 (day 1); 7th of 13 (day 2), 3–4 (plus a bye)
* [[Steve Marshall Viper's Day 1 I-10 Cup 1-20-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Steve Marshall]], 12th of 19 (day 1), 2–2
* [[Steve Marshall Viper's I-10 Cup Day 2 01-21-01 PHX (tournament report)]] — by [[Steve Marshall]], 10th of 13 (day 2); 9th of 10 two-day players, 1–2 (plus a bye)
* [[Brian Garrison Mesa AZ 2-24-01 Time to Play the Game (tournament report)]] — by [[Brian Garrison]], 5th overall

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub lists Justin Beal's finish as 3–0 (the record of his Court deck from his DeckTech deck post); his own report shows 3–4 plus a bye over the two days, 11th of 19 on day 1 and 7th of 13 on day 2.<ref name="tr-d1658" />
